definition: Brown's main all-you-can-eat dining hall, formally known as Sharpe Refectory. The nickname reportedly evolved from 'Sharpe Factory' to 'Rat Factory' to 'Ratty.' Located centrally off Main Green near Thayer Street, it's larger than the VDub with more variety. The Ratty is the heart of campus dining culture, referenced constantly in student life. Students joke about Ratty food quality while simultaneously eating there multiple times daily.
example: The Ratty is so mid today.

definition: Verney-Woolley Dining Hall, the second all-you-can-eat dining hall on Pembroke Campus. Smaller and more intimate than the Ratty, carpeted, and known for its make-your-own Belgian waffle station. The nickname follows Brown's pattern of abbreviating everything. Primarily serves first-years and athletes living on the north side of campus.
example: I love V-Dub. So do I.

definition: Chicken Finger Friday - Sacred weekly tradition at the V-Dub serving chicken fingers every Friday. This is a legitimate campus event that students anticipate all week. Missing CFF is considered a minor tragedy among Brown students who plan their Friday schedules around it.
example: Can't make it, it's CFF and I have priorities

definition: The most popular sandwich order at Jo's: spicy chicken with cheese. So culturally significant it has its own abbreviated name. Some students consider it 'UNDENIABLY the single best food offering at Brown.' You can also order a 'Spicy Without' (without cheese), though it's considered the 'lesser cousin.'
example: Spicy With please! Thanks

definition: Late-night campus eatery at 114 Power Street in Vartan Gregorian Quad, named after Professor Josiah Carberry. Open 6pm-2am daily, serving burgers, chicken sandwiches, fries, and onion rings. Essential destination for midnight cravings during finals and late-night study sessions.
example: Jo's is still open!!!!

definition: Features a wok station, wrap/sandwich station, pizza and pasta. Has weekend brunch with yogurt bowls and breakfast burritos. The lines can get very long, and people often cut in, which is a topic of controversy.
example: I am not waiting in that line

definition: Dining location below the Ratty with a make-your-own smoothie station, sushi, sandwiches, and nightly dinner specials. Open weekdays and Sunday dinner only. Considered the healthiest and freshest food on campus, where students go when they want to feel virtuous about their eating choices.
example: Why does Ivy Room have the most random fucking hours

definition: Campus café in Faunce House (Campus Center).
example: Blue Room sandwiches are BUSSS

definition: Endurance tradition of staying at the Ratty from opening (7:30am breakfast) through closing (7:30pm dinner).
example: Why did you do the Ratty Challenge? I don't know, I just wanted to feel something

definition: Pulling an all-nighter and eating at Louis Family Restaurant when it opens at 6am (formerly 5am pre-pandemic). A rite of passage for sleep-deprived students during finals, testing both stamina and commitment to questionable life choices.
example: We did the Louis Challenge last night and I genuinely can't tell if I'm still drunk or just exhausted

definition: Taking a shot on every floor of the SciLi.
example: Just did the SciLi challenge feeling blackout

definition: John D. Rockefeller Jr. Library, the main humanities library. Famous origin story: When the Rockefeller Foundation asked students to use the full name, students protested by calling it 'The John' (slang for toilet). The foundation quickly relented and approved 'The Rock.' This story perfectly encapsulates Brown's irreverent humor toward even its most prestigious benefactors.
example: I'll be at the Rock all day if anyone wants to suffer together

definition: Sciences Library, the 14-story brutalist building with floors color-coded to the pH scale. The top floor (the 13th) offers the highest views in Providence. Students study here during finals while contemplating both chemistry and their life choices from great heights.
example: SciLi 13th floor is either the best study spot or a depression trigger, no in between

definition: Smith-Buonanno Hall, a former Pembroke College gymnasium converted to classroom space. Built before Pembroke merged with Brown in 1971, it retains design elements of its gymnasium origins. Now known as a beautiful, high-tech building for classes.
example: Class in SmittyB in 5, see you there

definition: Morris-Champlin Hall, two first-year housing buildings in the same structure. The term also refers to the archway underneath where a cappella groups gather twice yearly to sing and attract new members during recruitment, creating midnight concerts that can be heard (and complained about) across campus.
example: MoChamp arch sings kept me up until 2am but honestly it was kind of worth it

definition: A nickname for the Vartan Gregorian Quadrangle.
example: Meet me at Greg in 10, I'm grabbing food from Jo's

definition: What Vartan Gregorian Quadrangle used to be called before current students started calling it 'Greg.'
example: My cousin graduated in 2019 and still calls it New Dorm, it's kind of funny

definition: Major first-year housing complex consisting of six connected houses forming an 'H' shape, housing about 600 freshmen. Nicknamed 'The Keeney Zoo' due to its loud, social party atmosphere where 'there's always something going on.' Features its own gym and underground tunnels. Students either love or fear being assigned to Keeney depending on their personality type.
example: Keeney is so loud I can hear someone's music three floors away, send help

definition: The most remote dorm on campus, about a 10+ minute walk from Main Green. Considered the most likely destination for sophomores in housing lottery, despite being the furthest from everything. Students joke about the '10-mile trek' and 'stock up on food before heading back' due to the distance from dining halls. Yet Perkins residents develop fierce loyalty to their close-knit community.
example: Got Perkins for next year, guess I'm buying a bike

definition: Quadrangle with nine residential buildings housing fraternities and independent students. Built 1950-1952, named after President Henry Wriston. Features underground tunnels originally built so fraternities could reach the Ratty without going outside, later used as Cold War bomb shelters. Centrally located social hub where the Ratty is located.
example: Wriston tunnels are creepy as hell but useful when it's raining

definition: Emery-Woolley, first-year housing on Pembroke Campus with bigger dorms and semi-private bathrooms. The basement has a reputation as a party space. Direct access to V-Dub means residents can 'roll out of bed to breakfast,' a significant quality-of-life advantage.
example: Em-Wool has the best bathrooms and that's the hill I'll die on

definition: Grad Center Bar, an upperclassmen favorite with cheap drinks, pool tables, and board games. Enter through what students describe as a 'sketchy-looking booth' at the top of Grad Center. One of the few on-campus bar options, making it an essential social space.
example: GCB tonight? Need to do something that isn't studying

definition: Brown's official term for 'major.' Not using this term marks you as an outsider immediately. Brown has 80+ concentrations students can choose from, or students can design an Independent Concentration.
example: What's your concentration? I'm still figuring mine out honestly

definition: Satisfactory/No Credit - Brown's pass/fail option and cornerstone of the Open Curriculum philosophy. Students can take any course S/NC (except concentration requirements), choosing their grading option by the end of the fourth week. So culturally significant it appears on fanny packs and hats. No other Ivy offers this flexibility.
example: Definitely taking this S/NC, I just want to learn without the grade stress

definition: Two-week period at the start of each semester when students can attend any class before committing, adding and dropping courses freely. After week two, changes require instructor override and fees. Unique Brown tradition that allows students to literally 'shop' for courses they want, trying before buying. Other schools don't trust their students with this freedom.
example: Shopping period is stressful, I've been to like 12 different classes

definition: Brown's defining academic feature adopted in 1969. No required courses outside your concentration (except two writing courses). No distribution requirements, no core curriculum. Students are 'architects of their own education.' This distinguishes Brown from every other Ivy and is mentioned in virtually every conversation about Brown academics.
example: The Open Curriculum is why I chose Brown, I'm not taking math ever again

definition: Course Performance Report - Not the medical procedure, but rather detailed written evaluations students can request from professors about their performance. Provides narrative feedback beyond letter grades, reflecting Brown's educational philosophy.
example: Just requested a CPR for my thesis, hoping for actual feedback

definition: Program in Liberal Medical Education - Guaranteed medical school admission without taking MCATs. As one student blog described: 'PLMEs are pretty much the envy and the bane of all other pre-med students... like gods among men.' Being accepted to PLME is considered winning the Brown admissions lottery.
example: She's PLME so she doesn't have to worry about MCATs, must be nice

definition: A Day on College Hill - Now a three-day admitted student visiting weekend in spring. Features campus tours, performances, showcases, and activities designed to convince prospective students to choose Brown. The acronym is used universally rather than the full name.
example: ADOCH was crazy, so many confused prospies everywhere

definition: Official term for Brown students and alumni, derived from the university's name. More formal than 'Brownies,' which some use informally though it's considered folksy. Being a Brunonian is an identity students carry proudly.
example: Ran into some fellow Brunonians at the coffee shop in Providence

definition: Brown's beloved fictional professor of 'psychoceramics' (the study of cracked pots). Created as a joke in 1929 when a notice appeared for a lecture that never happened, he evolved into an elaborate running joke with a fake family, fake publications in real academic journals, and his own Wikipedia entry. His motto: 'Dulce et Decorum Est Desipere in Loco' ('It is pleasant and proper to be foolish once in a while'). This perfectly encapsulates Brown's irreverent intellectual humor.
example: Josiah Carberry is my academic role model and he doesn't even exist

definition: Every Friday the 13th and leap day (February 29), cracked pots (brown jugs) are placed around campus for donations to the Josiah S. Carberry Fund. Money buys books 'Professor Carberry might or might not approve of.' The fund was established in 1955 with an initial donation of $101.01. Students actively participate in this tradition honoring a professor who never existed.
example: It's Friday the 13th, time to donate to the Carberry Fund

definition: Naked Donut Run - The most elusive and exclusive Brown tradition. During Reading Period before finals, anonymous students streak through campus libraries (The Rock, SciLi, CIT) distributing donuts to stressed students. Nobody knows exactly when it will occur—you need an 'in' to become a Runner. Briefly interrupted by security in 2010 but allowed to continue. Post-pandemic, many underclassmen were unaware until witnessing it firsthand, creating mystique around this stress-relief ritual.
example: I just witnessed NDR and I have so many questions but also free donuts

definition: Ornamental entrance gates built in 1901 that open only three times: inward at Convocation to welcome freshmen, mid-year students at their convocation, and outward at Commencement for graduates to exit. Superstition says if you walk through more than twice, women won't marry and men won't graduate. To break the curse: kiss someone under the Soldier's Field Arch at midnight. This tradition symbolizes the journey through Brown.
example: Don't walk through Van Wickle Gates or you're cursed, I don't make the rules

definition: Brown's major annual music festival since 1950 (originally 'Junior Week' in 1901). Features major acts performing on Main Green Saturday afternoon—past performers include Bob Dylan, Janis Joplin, Bruce Springsteen, U2, Kendrick Lamar, Chance the Rapper. Students plan outfits weeks ahead. Off-campus parties throughout Providence. Organized entirely by the Brown Concert Agency (BCA), a student group managing hundreds of thousands of dollars.
example: Spring Weekend lineup just dropped and it's actually fire this year

definition: Annual tradition at Sayles Hall where the University organist plays death-themed music at midnight on Halloween using the world's largest remaining Hutchings-Votey organ. Always ends with Bach's Toccata and Fugue in D Minor. Students attend in costumes with lights off for maximum spooky atmosphere.
example: Halloween organ concert was genuinely terrifying in the best way

definition: Legend says stepping on the seal in stone steps leading to Pembroke Campus means female students will get pregnant before graduation; male students won't graduate at all. Recently criticized as sexist, but many students still avoid it 'just in case.' The superstition reflects Pembroke's history as Brown's former women's college.
example: I know the Pembroke Seal thing is bullshit but I still walk around it

definition: Pre-finals stress relief tradition where students gather and scream, typically during finals period. A collective cathartic release of academic anxiety that bonds students through shared suffering.
example: Primal Scream tonight, I need to let it all out before this exam

definition: Delta Phi fraternity, located in Diman House on Wriston Quad. Known for close-knit, social atmosphere. Brown has minimal Greek presence compared to other Ivies, but these organizations maintain their identity.
example: Party at DPhi tonight if you want to come

definition: Delta Tau fraternity in Sears House, known for laid-back attitudes. About 10% of Brown students participate in Greek life, far less than most peer institutions.
example: DTau's vibe is way more chill than the other frats

definition: Kappa Alpha Theta sorority in Diman House. One of four residential Panhellenic sororities on campus.
example: Theta's having a mixer this weekend

definition: Delta Gamma sorority in Goddard House. Along with other Greek organizations, considered disaffiliation during the 2020 Abolish Greek Life movement.
example: DG's philanthropy event is next Thursday

definition: Kappa Delta sorority in Harkness House. Part of Brown's small but present Greek system.
example: She's rushing KD this semester

definition: Alpha Delta Phi, gender-inclusive literary society (went co-ed in 1973) housed in Goddard House. Reflects Brown's progressive approach to Greek life.
example: ADPhi actually has interesting events beyond just parties

definition: Zeta Delta Xi, gender-inclusive organization in Marcy House. One of Brown's independent residential Greek organizations.
example: Zete's parties are always weird in the best way possible

definition: Alpha Epsilon Pi fraternity. National organization with chapter at Brown.
example: AEPi's having their annual event on Friday

definition: Brown Concert Agency - Student organization that plans Spring Weekend. Fully student-run, managing a budget of several hundred thousand dollars to book major musical acts, coordinate logistics, and execute Brown's biggest annual event. Being on BCA is considered prestigious and exhausting.
example: BCA just announced the lineup and I'm losing my mind

definition: Undergraduate Council of Students - Student government at Brown. Handles student advocacy, policy recommendations, and representation to administration.
example: UCS elections are coming up, you should vote

definition: Brown Daily Herald - Independent student-run daily newspaper since 1866. Referenced constantly as 'the BDH' or simply 'the Herald.' Source of campus news, commentary, and occasional controversy.
example: Did you see the BDH article about housing? It's blowing up

definition: Brown University Shuttle - Campus shuttle service running day and night, taking students anywhere on campus with Brown ID. Sometimes still called 'SafeRide' after the previous company, though students are phasing out the old name as older students graduate.
example: Taking the BUS back from the library because it's freezing

definition: Brown Outdoor Leadership Training - Pre-orientation wilderness experience for incoming students involving 'lots of bonding and nature peeing,' as one student blog memorably described it. Creates immediate friend groups before classes start.
example: My best friends are all from BOLT, that trip bonded us for life

definition: Beloved electric blue teddy bear statue that was removed from campus. Students mourned its loss extensively. The abstract sculpture that replaced it was derisively nicknamed 'Poono,' demonstrating students' attachment to Blueno as a campus icon.
example: I miss Blueno, Poono just isn't the same

definition: Nickname for President Christina Paxson. Students use this abbreviation when discussing the president in casual conversation.
example: CPax sent out another email about campus COVID policies

definition: Annual fall party thrown by the Brown Queer Alliance, notorious for racy promotional campaigns. Gained national attention after Bill O'Reilly coverage in 2005, cementing its place in Brown lore as a symbol of the campus's progressive social culture.
example: SexPowerGod is this weekend and the theme is absolutely wild

definition: The historic Providence neighborhood where Brown is located. Students reference 'getting off College Hill' or 'life on the Hill' as shorthand for the Brown bubble versus the real world. Housing prices here are significantly higher than the rest of Providence due to Brown's presence since 1764.
example: Need to get off College Hill this weekend, feeling too bubbled

definition: North side of campus, formerly Pembroke College (the women's coordinate college that merged with Brown in 1971). Still referred to as a distinct area with its own identity, facilities, and culture. Students 'on Pembroke' have a different campus experience than those centrally located.
example: I'm on Pembroke so I basically live at the V-Dub

definition: Upperclass academic peer counselors (pronounced 'nickel-john' with an M). First-years are assigned a Meiklejohn to help navigate academic decisions, course selection, and concentration choice. The unusual pronunciation is part of Brown vocabulary.
example: My Meiklejohn helped me figure out which classes to shop

definition: Modern Culture and Media - Academic department known for offering quirky courses like 'Perverse Cinema' and 'Anime Studies.' Referenced frequently as the concentration for students interested in film, media theory, and cultural studies.
example: MCM has the most interesting course titles I've ever seen

definition: A cappella group performances under the MoChamp arch happening twice yearly when groups gather to sing and recruit new members.
example: Arch sings are happening tonight by the way

definition: Rhode Island Public Transportation Authority, the public bus system. Brown students get free access with Brown ID. While not Brown-specific, RIPTA usage is central to student life for getting around Providence and to nearby areas.
example: Taking RIPTA downtown, anyone want to come?

definition: International fraternity known for its posh, exclusive atmosphere and wealthy international student membership. Has a reputation for being pretentious and gate-keeping. Was kicked off campus, but reformed under a different name (BUGS) as a shell organisation.
example: Does anyone actually like Buxton other than Buxton?

definition: Campus legend that became a thing through Sidechat when some guy kept posting about someone allegedly tickling students' feet in Wriston dorms. Whether real or an elaborate online joke, it became embedded in Brown meme culture and is referenced constantly. The mystery of whether the Tickler actually existed or was just Sidechat bait remains unsolved.
example: Someone brought up the Wriston Quad Tickler again on Sidechat, this will never die

definition: Anonymous messaging app that became essential to Brown campus culture. Students use it to share memes, gossip, campus complaints, hot takes, and inside jokes. The source of many modern Brown legends and controversies. Where campus discourse happens unfiltered, for better or worse. Has created its own micro-culture within Brown.
example: Did you see the Sidechat drama about the Ratty? It's unhinged

definition: Exclusive off-campus club house run by Buxton and DPhi that they're weirdly secretive about. Members act like having access to Fones makes them special and elite.
example: Oh you don't know Fones?

definition: Originally Phi Psi, got kicked off campus for rape about 10 years ago and decided that being off campus is actually not so bad because it makes them seem kind of special and underground. They throw decent parties, but that's about it.
example: Lantern's having something tonight, it'll probably be fine

definition: The Lantern frat house where senior brothers live. Gets absolutely trashed every single weekend from parties.
example: Where is the Lantern function? The Shack. Duhhh?

definition: Program house for students interested in technology. Not really a frat. Exactly what you'd esxpect a house full of CS students to be like. So like, kind of wierd, but I guess they're not hurting anybody.
example: Tech House is microwaving random shit tonight, should be fun

definition: The central quad at Brown and the heart of campus. Where students study, hang out, play frisbee, and gather for major events like Spring Weekend and 4/20. Surrounded by historic buildings and basically the living room of Brown. If something important is happening on campus, it's probably on the Main Green.
example: Famous last words: I'm going to study on the Main Green

definition: Andrews lunch on Tuesday. People love it, and so talk about it. Not sure what makes the noodles dry.
example: I am not waiting in that line

definition: A Night on College Hill. The CCB ball. It's pretty mid, let's hope you have better things to go to.
example: Are you going to ANOCH? Hmmmm, like maybe?

definition: Unofficial Brown holiday on April 20th when the Main Green transforms into a massive smoke session. Students gather, especially at 4:20am and 4:20pm (when massive smoke clouds rise), and hang out. Some students camp out all night. Everyone loves 4/20.
example: You going to the Main Green for 4/20? Obviously
